verdict.rationale: Unleash documents 15 official client and server SDKs (30+ in total including community SDKs) covering all major languages. Backend tokens serve backend SDKs and frontend tokens are safe to expose client-side, and a community comment names official Java, Node.js, Go, Ruby and Python clients. Backend and web coverage is clearly evidenced, but mobile SDKs and consistent cross-SDK flag evaluation are not shown. Missing for 10: explicit evidence of official mobile SDKs (iOS/Android/React Native/Flutter), documentation of consistent evaluation semantics across SDKs, hands-on corroboration of multi-platform use.
